_README: COPY this to style_spec.json and re-point every field at the CURRENT brand. Nothing here is a default to trust: derive each value from the brand's OWN published assets in Phase A. The palette below is a deliberately synthetic placeholder (pure greys plus one stock blue), not a real brand.

palette_roles.box_stroke_primary: <their box outline hex and stroke weight>
palette_roles.heading_text: <label hex; note font family and weight>
palette_roles.accent: <the accent hex(es) they actually use, and what for>

style_notes.fills: <outline-only, tinted or solid fills; shadows or none>
style_notes.connectors: <stroke weight, arrowhead, what solid vs dashed means>
